data.text: AI can write code fast. That’s no longer the interesting part. I want to know what survives review, deployment, real users and the next 90 days. The best coding agent may simply be the one that creates the least cleanup. #AI #SoftwareEngineering #AICoding https://t.co/25RDBdROhI
